custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have at least one active part at the test location, so Export has a part to export.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425599-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425599-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
  • Export is in the Inventory list's three-dot actions menu (with Cycle count and Deactivate parts); it downloads a file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 3:

  • The menu holds a single entry, "Export".
  • "Cycle count" and "Deactivate parts" are not offered.

Step 4:

  • A file downloads, and the dark bar is still shown: bulk mode stays on.

Step 5:

  • Bulk mode ends.

Step 6:

  • With bulk mode ended, the menu again lists "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R10b: “While the mode is on, the actions menu offers only Export. Cycle count and the bulk entry come back when the mode ends.”
  • S2-E4: “Cycle count and bulk status mode cannot both be on. While Cycle count runs, the actions menu is replaced by the count controls, so the bulk status entry cannot be reached until the count is saved or discarded. While bulk status mode is on, the menu does not offer Cycle count (S2-R10b).”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
